data.title: Efficacy of everolimus in advanced renal cell carcinoma: a double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled phase III trial

evidence.label: Human study
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Everolimus extended median progression-free survival from 1.9 to 4.0 months versus placebo in metastatic renal cell carcinoma.
data.abstract_excerpt: Everolimus (RAD001) is an orally administered inhibitor of the mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR), a therapeutic target for metastatic renal cell carcinoma. We did a phase III, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of everolimus in patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma whose disease had progressed on vascular endothelial growth factor-targeted therapy.

extracted_findings.species: Human – phase III RCT (RECORD-1), metastatic renal cell carcinoma
extracted_findings.effect: Everolimus improved progression-free survival vs placebo after VEGF-targeted therapy failure
